repository_blockers.description: Supply final original App Store icon artwork and populate AppIcon.appiconset. Temporary Irasutoya character art must not be treated as final brand artwork by default.

completed_asset_requirements.description: The three verified OtoLogic MP3 files are committed as SwiftPM Audio resources, semantic IDs resolve through BundleAudioCuePlayer, and the exact CC BY 4.0 credit is exposed in-app.

All four approved temporary Irasutoya character works are committed for Web and SwiftPM behind semantic IDs, remain below the 20-work limit, and have source/provenance plus SHA256 recorded in Release/AssetManifest.json.

external_upload_gate: A signed TestFlight/App Store upload must not be claimed until the external Apple account/signing inputs are supplied and a real upload succeeds.
